description: This is a test class for the ActilityProvider, verifying its methods for extracting device IDs, payloads, message types, RSSI, and gateways from LoRaWAN messages in JSON format. It contains unit tests using JUnit for the ActilityProvider class related to the LoRa adapter.

classes.name: ActilityProviderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying behaviors of ActilityProvider related to extracting data from LoRa messages.

methods.name: extractDeviceIdFromLoraMessage
methods.description: Test that the provider correctly extracts the device ID from a LoRa message.

methods.name: extractPayloadFromLoraMessage
methods.description: Test that the provider correctly extracts the payload from a LoRa message.

methods.name: extractTypeFromLoraUplinkMessage
methods.description: Test that the provider correctly extracts message type (UPLINK) from a LoRa message.

methods.name: extractTypeFromLoraUnknownMessage
methods.description: Test that the provider defaults to UNKNOWN message type when message content is unrecognized.

methods.name: extractRssiFromLoraMessage
methods.description: Test that the provider correctly extracts RSSI value from a LoRa message.

methods.name: extractGatewaysFromLoraMessage
methods.description: Test that the provider correctly extracts gateways array with ids, RSSI, and SNR values.
